question: If 35 percent of P = 60 percent of Q and Q is (z/3) percent of P, then what is the value of z?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Q to P → Q / P = 35% ÷ 60% = 7 / 12

Given Q is (z/3)% of P → Q / P = z / 300

Equating both values → z / 300 = 7 / 12

z = (300 × 7) ÷ 12 = 175

**∴ The correct answer is 175.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

35% of P = 60% of Q

Q = (z/3)% of P

 
• 
 
 
 P (12 parts)
 
 
 Q (7 parts)
 
 

 Q / P = 7 / 12
 
 35% P = 60% Q
 
 Q = (z/3)% of P → z = 300 × (7/12) = 175

**Calculations:**

⇒ (35 / 100) × P = (60 / 100) × Q

⇒ 35P = 60Q

⇒ Q / P = 35 / 60

⇒ Q / P = 7 / 12

According to the second condition:

⇒ Q = (z / 3)% of P

⇒ Q = [z ÷ (3 × 100)] × P

⇒ Q / P = z / 300

Equating the two values of Q / P:

⇒ z / 300 = 7 / 12

⇒ z = (7 × 300) ÷ 12

⇒ z = 2100 ÷ 12

⇒ z = 175

**∴ The correct answer is 175.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Ratio Conversion

To convert a percentage into a fraction or ratio, strictly divide the given percentage value by 100 and simplify. Example: x% = x/100.

Percentage Equivalence

If A% of B = C% of D, then the ratio of B to D is inversely proportional to their respective percentage coefficients. Thus, B/D = C/A.

A is x% of B

This relationship easily translates to the algebraic form A = (x/100) × B, allowing direct calculation for any missing parameter.
